questions.markdown: A rectangular pulse is defined as $x(t)=\begin{cases}A, & 0<t<T\\0, & \text{otherwise}\end{cases}$. $x(t)$ is applied to an integrator defined by $y(t)=\int_0^t x(\tau)\,d\tau$. Find the total energy of the signal $y(2t)$.
Given $x(t)=\begin{cases}5-t, & 4\le t\le 5\\1, & -4\le t\le 4\\t+5, & -5\le t\le -4\\0, & \text{otherwise}\end{cases}$. Plot the signal. Also plot $x(10t-5)$.

The impulse response of RC filter is given by $h(t)=e^{-t}u(t)$. Using convolution, determine its output for the input i) $x(t)=e^{-|t|}$ ii) $x(t)$ is unity height pulse extending from $t=-1$ to $t=1$.
Determine and sketch the output for a system defined by impulse response $h(n)=(0.25)\{u[n]-u[n-5]\}$ if the input is $x[n]=u[n]-u[n-10]$.

Sketch the block diagram representation for the following systems. The realization should be using minimum number of delay units or integrators.

i) $y[n]+2y[n-2]-3y[n-3]=x[n-1]+5x[n-2]$

ii) $\dfrac{d^2}{dt^2}y(t)-2\dfrac{d}{dt}y(t)+3y(t)=\dfrac{d}{dt}x(t)+x(t)$

Determine convolution of the signals using Fourier representation

$x_1[n]=\left(\dfrac12\right)^n u[n]$

$x_2[n]=\left(\dfrac12\right)^n u[n]$

questions.markdown:
Determine the DTFS coefficient of the following signal using method of inspection

$x[n]=\cos\left(\dfrac{\pi n}{4}+\phi\right)$

Determine the Fourier Transforms of the following signal using tables of transforms and properties

$x(t)=\dfrac{d}{dt}e^{-2t}u(t)$

Determine frequency response and impulse response of the system described by the following differential equation using Fourier representation

$$
\dfrac{d^2}{dt^2}y(t)+5\dfrac{d}{dt}y(t)+6y(t)=-\dfrac{d}{dt}x(t)
$$

Consider the system depicted in the Fig 4B.2 and let the Fourier transform of the input signal $x(t)$ is depicted in Fig 4B.1. Sketch $Z(j\omega)$ and $Y(j\omega)$ for $w(t)=\cos(3\pi t)$ and $h(t)=\dfrac{\sin(6\pi t)}{\pi t}$.

questions.markdown:
Consider the sinusoidal signal $x(t)=3\cos(3000\pi t)$ and the sampling frequency is 2 KHz.

a) Determine the expression of the sampled sequence and plot it.

b) Plot the Fourier transform of the sampled sequence.

For the system $H(Z)=\dfrac{1-0.8z^{-1}+16z^{-2}}{1-\dfrac12 z^{-1}+\dfrac14 z^{-2}}$ identify the transfer function of the inverse system, and determine whether the inverse system can be both causal and stable

Determine the impulse response of the system characterized by

$y(n)=2.5y(n-1)-y(n-2)+x(n)-5x(n-1)+6x(n-2)$ using z-transform

Determine the transfer function, impulse response and the step response for the system represented by

$$
\dfrac{d^2}{dt^2}y(t)+5\dfrac{d}{dt}y(t)+6y(t)=\dfrac{d}{dt}x(t)+x(t)
$$

using Laplace transform.
